name: Avorion
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The co-op space sandbox: build ships from scalable blocks, trade, fight and claim a procedural galaxy. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; ini="galaxy/{{GALAXY_NAME}}/server.ini"; if [ ! -f "$ini" ]; then mkdir -p "galaxy/{{GALAXY_NAME}}"; printf "[System]\nbackupsPath=/home/container/backups\n" > "$ini"; elif grep -q "^backupsPath=$" "$ini"; then sed -i "s|^backupsPath=$|backupsPath=/home/container/backups|" "$ini"; fi; for k in sendCrashReports hangDetection; do if grep -q "^$k=" "$ini"; then sed -i "s/^$k=.*/$k={{CRASH_REPORTS}}/" "$ini"; else sed -i "/^\[System\]/a $k={{CRASH_REPORTS}}" "$ini"; fi; done; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="./linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"; exec ./bin/AvorionServer --galaxy-name "{{GALAXY_NAME}}" --datapath galaxy --admin {{ADMIN_ID}} --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --query-port {{QUERY_PORT}} --steam-query-port {{STEAM_QUERY_PORT}} --steam-master-port {{STEAM_MASTER_PORT}} --server-name "{{SERVER_NAME}}" --max-players {{MAX_PLAYERS}} --difficulty {{DIFFICULTY}} --collision-damage {{COLLISION_DMG}} --save-interval {{SAVE_INTERVAL}} --same-start-sector {{SAME_START_SECTOR}} --threads {{GAME_THREADS}} --listed {{SERVER_LISTED}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Avorion. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 565060) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Galaxies and their settings (galaxy/) are
# never touched; the startup only points the game's backups into backups/
# (it looks for a home folder the server's user doesn't have).
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-565060}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

echo "Installed Avorion build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Galaxy
variables.description: The galaxy to load, or create when there's none by that name.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Admin Steam ID
variables.description: The 17-digit Steam ID of the player who administers the server.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: From -3 (easiest) to 3 (hardest), used when the galaxy is created.

variables.name: Collision damage
variables.description: How much damage colliding objects take, from 0 (none) to 1 (full).

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the galaxy is saved, in seconds.

variables.name: Same start sector
variables.description: true starts every player in the same sector; false gives each a sector of their own on the outer rim.

variables.name: Listed
variables.description: true lists the server in the public server list.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port the game's own query uses; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Steam query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Steam master port
variables.description: The port Steam's master server talks to; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, such as beta, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.

variables.name: Crash reports
variables.description: Send crash and hang reports to the game's developers (true or false).
